description: A two-factor screen with a six-digit code input, a resend timer and a confirmation once verified.
overview: An `InputOTP` with six slots checks the code when the last digit is entered; a wrong code shakes the input and shows an error, and a correct one shows a verified screen. A resend link counts down from 30 seconds, and a help link sits below.
usage: `onVerify` receives the code and returns a boolean or a promise; by default it accepts the demo code `482913`. `onHelp` handles the help link.
